elements.text:
Bring a book
We bring the tea
Ask about the bottle on the shelf
baked down the road this morning
one wedge, one spoon of honey

Tell us if you do not eat something.
We will find you a plate.

A free open afternoon
for anyone under twelve,
and the grown ups
who come along.
Sign up at the bar from 19:00. Three songs each, no more.

Ines, Otto, Mira, Sam, Lo and Bea,
the two from upstairs, Frank from
number nine, and everyone
else who says yes.
and you, if you bring a spoon
A dish for four, a chair if you have one

A walk along the
shoreline, nine
kilometres, with
coffee halfway.

Saturday 10 May
Meet at the ferry quay
09:30

Bring water, wear
shoes you like.
Dogs welcome.

Anna and Jacob
are getting married
and want you at the table.

Five o’clock, under the apple trees.
Dinner at seven.
A bed in the barn if you need one.
How we think before we make
